payload.rationale: The document is a sprint retro about shipping the async decision widget, velocity, and the Zephyr integration. I used the perspective map and expanded the narratives and positions these bear on: the anti-Slack positioning narrative, the decisions-evaporate problem narrative, and the zero-effort capture and decision-capture-at-consensus narratives. I also expanded the Sprint 4 positions the retro itself witnesses (Zephyr unlock, thesis proven, webhook architecture, pricing tier 25+, context preservation next sprint) and the pricing and core-feature and anti-pattern positions they touch. I did not expand the Thematic area list beyond its single unexpanded area (the Narrative_AntiSlackPositioning root), nor the ProductCategoryAsyncPlatform and TargetMarketRemoteTeams positions, since they only brush this retro. The People door is empty and there are no Dimensions or Unplaced entries, so no person or loose-position axis needed opening.

resolutions.phrase: We shipped the async decision widget. Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter. The Zephyr integration was the key unlock.

referents.why: The 'async decision widget' is the widget this position describes (intercepts consensus, creates a persistent record); the retro adds the shipping event and velocity detail.
Names the Zephyr integration as 'the key unlock', adding Tanya's confirmation to the recorded Sprint 4 claim.

resolutions.why: Both references converge on the Sprint 4 retro cluster: the widget and the Zephyr unlock are specific leaves under Narrative_ZeroEffortCapture, and the statement is a Sprint 4 retro assertion. The '23 points' velocity figure has no prior node and rides along as fresh detail.

reconciliations.note: We shipped the async decision widget. Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter. The Zephyr integration was the key unlock.

positions.name: Sprint4ShipAndUnlock
positions.frame: what did the sprint actually ship, and what made it land?
positions.why: One statement carries a whole frame on its own: a completed shipping event, a velocity figure, and the named unlock that made it possible. The temporal read is past/realis/concrete — settled fact, no hedge — and the relational read is communal ('We shipped'), attributing the work to the team as one body. The value read appeals to standing through the comparative 'highest this quarter', and the conviction read is plain unhedged assertion rather than a performed decision. The three clauses cohere as one retrospective account of what was delivered and why it worked, so they are read together rather than split.

placements.why: The single position this document mints carries a completed shipping event for the async decision widget, a velocity figure, and the Zephyr integration named as the unlock. The widget is the artifact of capturing a decision at the moment of consensus and linking it to the context that produced it — the exact theme Narrative_DecisionCaptureAtConsensus already holds. The velocity figure and the ship event are position-grain evidence for that theme, not a theme of their own (rule 2), so no leaf is minted for them. The position pass proposed this leaf and the proposal is taken.

unconnected.why: No stratum is minted here: this document contributes one position holding one retrospective statement, and no grouping relationship across members is legible from a single position. No existing stratum holds it either — the org's strata space is empty.
